stemEn: A 13-year-old boy with short stature has delayed bone age and early pubertal development. What is the most likely diagnosis?

options.text: Constitutional delay of growth and puberty

explanationAr: Delayed bone age مع otherwise healthy adolescent وpubertal delay يرجح Constitutional delay of growth and puberty (CDGP). هؤلاء غالبًا يصلون إلى adult height مناسب بعد catch-up growth.
reasoningEn: Delayed bone age with delayed pubertal tempo is classic for constitutional delay of growth and puberty.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: CDGP is a normal variant but is a diagnosis made after excluding pathologic causes when indicated.

stemEn: A 14-year-old boy remains Tanner stage I and has a bone age delayed by three years. What is the next step?

options.text: Reassurance if the pattern is consistent with constitutional delay

recalledAnswer: A, but B may be appropriate if evaluation is incomplete
explanationAr: العمر 14 سنة مع Tanner I يحتاج التأكد من عدم وجود pathologic delayed puberty. إذا كانت القصة والنمو والفحص متوافقة بوضوح مع CDGP وبعد تقييم مناسب يمكن reassurance، لكن السؤال ناقص لذلك يبقى للمراجعة.
reasoningEn: A 14-year-old boy with no pubertal onset warrants evaluation unless constitutional delay has already been adequately established.
incorrectOptionsAr: Growth hormone ليس العلاج الروتيني لـCDGP؛ reassurance وحده لا يكفي إذا لم يكتمل التقييم.
clinicalPearl: Delayed puberty in boys is generally absence of testicular enlargement by age 14.

stemEn: A teenager with short stature has delayed bone age and a family history of late puberty; both parents are of average height. What should the family be told?

options.text: Adult height is expected to be acceptable
She will definitely be taller than her mother

explanationAr: في CDGP يكون bone age delayed ويستمر النمو لفترة أطول، لذلك final adult height غالبًا يقترب من genetic potential.
reasoningEn: Constitutional delay usually preserves adult height potential because skeletal maturation is delayed.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن الجزم بأنها ستكون أطول من الأم، كما أن قصر الطول النهائي الشديد ليس المتوقع عادة إذا كان هذا CDGP حقيقيًا.
clinicalPearl: Use midparental height and growth velocity when counseling.

stemEn: A 13-year-old boy with short stature has several possible bone-age results. Which result best suggests substantial remaining growth potential?
explanationAr: Bone age 9 سنوات عند عمر chronologic 13 يعني skeletal maturation متأخر، وبالتالي يوجد remaining growth potential أكبر. لكنه لا يثبت وحده أن السبب benign.
reasoningEn: A markedly delayed bone age indicates more remaining skeletal growth potential.
incorrectOptionsAr: Bone ages 14–17 تعني maturation أقرب أو متقدمة وبالتالي growth potential أقل.
clinicalPearl: Delayed bone age can occur in CDGP but also systemic disease and GH deficiency.

stemEn: A girl's father is 158 cm and mother is 150 cm. Which value is closest to her midparental target height?
explanationAr: للبنت: (father height + mother height − 13) ÷ 2 = (158 + 150 − 13)/2 = 147.5 cm. أقرب خيار هو 145 cm.
reasoningEn: Female midparental height is approximately (father + mother - 13 cm) / 2.
incorrectOptionsAr: بقية الأرقام أبعد عن الناتج 147.5 cm.
clinicalPearl: Target-height range is usually considered around ±8.5 cm depending on method.

stemEn: A child has height below the 3rd percentile, growth velocity 3 cm/year, and low IGF-1. What should occur before committing to growth hormone treatment?

options.text: Confirm the diagnosis with an appropriate GH-axis evaluation/stimulation testing when indicated
Start growth hormone solely because IGF-1 is low

recalledAnswer: Source listed growth hormone, but noted stimulation testing should precede treatment if available
explanationAr: Low IGF-1 مع poor growth velocity يرفع الشك في GH deficiency لكنه لا يكفي وحده. يجب تقييم causes أخرى ثم confirmation حسب endocrine protocol قبل بدء GH.
reasoningEn: Low IGF-1 is supportive but not diagnostic by itself; growth hormone deficiency generally requires a structured endocrine evaluation.
incorrectOptionsAr: بدء GH مباشرةً من IGF-1 منخفض فقط قد يؤدي لعلاج تشخيص غير مؤكد.
clinicalPearl: Interpret IGF-1 by age, pubertal stage, nutrition, and chronic illness.

stemEn: An 8-year-old girl with Turner syndrome has significant short stature. Which therapy is appropriate at this age to improve adult height?
explanationAr: في Turner syndrome يمكن بدء recombinant growth hormone في الطفولة لتحسين final height. Estrogen يستخدم لاحقًا لبدء puberty عادة حول العمر المناسب، وprogesterone يضاف بعد estrogen عند الحاجة.
reasoningEn: Growth hormone is used in childhood Turner syndrome to improve adult height before pubertal induction.
incorrectOptionsAr: Estrogen/progesterone ليستا العلاج المناسب الأساسي لقصر الطول في عمر 8 سنوات.
clinicalPearl: Turner short stature does not require GH deficiency to justify GH therapy.
